AND ZONING ORDINANCE, AS AMENDED; TO PROVIDE THAT THE REGULATION OF SIGNS SHALL BE DONE BY A SEPARATE SIGN ORDINANCE FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, AND WHICH SHALL OPERATE IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE PLANNING AND ZONING ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. .

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia is authorized by 0. C. G. A. § 36-66-1, et seq. and the Town Charter, to exercise its police power to enact and amend a zoning ordinance for land use regulations as to property within the Town of Clermont, Georgia; and

WHEREAS, Article V of the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, as amended, being Ordinance No. 97-01, as amended, regulates and governs the erection, alteration, construction, and reconstruction of signs within the Town of Clermont,

Georgia;

WHEREAS, the Town Council finds that it is appropriate to update the regulations of the Town of Clermont governing signs, and to provide for the regulation of signs by way of a separate Sign Ordinance for the Town of Clermont, Georgia,

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, is providing for the regulation of signs by a separate Sign Ordinance, and therefore the Town Council finds that it is appropriate to delete in its entirety, Article V of the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, as amended, with the deletion becoming effective upon the effective date of the Sign Ordinance of the Town of Clermont.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED, by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the above-referenced authority, as follows:
4: The foregoing recitals shall be a part of this ordinance and included within the record and. as a basis for the zoning text amendment to the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, as amended, and shall be included upon the official public minutes of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
7: amended, and being designated as Ordinance No. 97-01, which was duly passed on March 4, 1997, is hereby amended by striking in its entirety the provisions of Article V and substituting in lieu thereof the following, and which shall read as follows:
11:
The regulation of signs, including their use upon property zoned by the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, shall be in accordance with a separate Sign Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, and as duly ordained by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia. The Sign Ordinance, due to the fact that it regulates the use of signs within the zoning districts established by the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, as amended, is a form of zoning ordinance, but shall be a separate zoning ordinance that operates in conjunction with the Planning and Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Clermont,

Georgia, as amended.
12: All parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed to the extent of the conflict.
13: If any portion of this ordinance shall be invalid or unconstitutional, such invalidity or unconstitutionality shall not affect and impair the remaining portions unless it clearly appears that other parts are wholly and necessarily dependent upon the part held to be invalid or unconstitutional.
14:
The effective date of this ordinance shall be upon its approval, or upon the effective date of the Sign Ordinance of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, whichever is the latest in effect.
